# Provider fixtures

This directory contains sanitized-real Claude usage responses. Their strings, numbers, dates, names, balances, and reset values are deterministic synthetic values. The current-schema fixture also retains only the authorized public-safe window shape, numeric range class, and timestamp parse classification.

The Codex fixture remains unavailable because its single authorized capture attempt failed without producing a response fixture. The machine-checked status is in `../evidence/provider-fixtures.json`; `unavailable` does not certify provider compatibility and keeps that human release proof open.
